name: German marketing coordinator switching into paid performance marketing

context.occupation: Marketing coordinator transitioning to performance marketing
context.seniority: Midcareer overall; junior in campaign performance specialization
context.employment_state: Employed and exploring a career switch
constraints: Paid employment rather than unpaid work or another course
Junior label must not imply student enrollment
context.company_awareness: Open to agencies or in-house teams; no fixed employer list

trigger: A junior search returns degree requirements, student-only positions and course advertisements despite an existing portfolio.

searches_run.query: Junior Performance Marketing Jobs Quereinsteiger ohne Studium
searches_run.observation: Retrieval mixed actual roles, training-provider results and vacancies offering degree alternatives. One attractive explicitly no-degree result was in Switzerland, showing language match did not establish German location fit.

searches_run.query: Performance Marketing Einstieg ohne Studium bezahlte Stelle kein Praktikum Zertifikat Portfolio
searches_run.observation: Results included paid role pages and substantial training content. Direct Cyrus inspection states employee status, a salary range and no prior experience required; it lists Munich residence/relocation and does not state a degree requirement. Omission is not a guarantee of acceptance.

sources.title: Performance Marketing Manager Quereinsteiger — Cyrus Digital
sources.supports: Direct employer-authored posting states employment, salary range, no prior experience and Munich residence/relocation. No degree is listed; candidate acceptance and portfolio sufficiency remain unverified.

sources.title: Quereinsteiger Performance Marketing Jobs — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved category includes training-provider language and a career-change role asking for a quantitative degree plus practice, illustrating mixed entry requirements.

sources.title: Junior Performance Marketing 20–40% — QYOU
sources.supports: Retrieved Swiss listing explicitly downplays formal education but is located in Pratteln, not Germany.

sources.title: Junior Performance Marketing Manager — Start To Finish Consulting
sources.supports: Retrieved junior posting asks for a completed quantitative degree and treats projects as a plus; historical date wording prevents assuming a current vacancy.

best_entry_page.primary_query: Performance Marketing Quereinstieg ohne Studium Jobs
best_entry_page.promise: Show how to distinguish paid junior marketing employment from courses and student roles, and identify explicitly alternative qualification wording.
proof_needed: Original requirement wording with required/preferred distinctions
Employment type and location alongside junior label
No-degree omission separated from explicit alternative acceptance
Free search explained without pushing paid courses
No portfolio or certification acceptance guarantee
New indexable guide; search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Is this an actual paid vacancy or a course lead?
Does junior require being enrolled at university?
Will employers consider my work rather than automatically demand a degree?
Can I use the free search before paying?
Is the job campaign analysis or mostly cold sales?

avoid_targeting.reason: Training acquisition is not this persona's goal or product function.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Ich bringe Berufserfahrung, ein Portfolio und ein Zertifikat mit und suche eine bezahlte Chance im Performance Marketing. Zeigt mir echte Anforderungen und Beschäftigungsarten, statt mich wieder zu einer Weiterbildung zu schicken.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, two searches and one direct employer-authored inspection. No city, willingness to relocate or educational equivalence assumed. Other queries are hypotheses. No salary advice, hiring guarantee or entry-market prevalence inferred. Employment/experience filters exist; degree-free hiring verification does not.

search_journey.fit_reason: Broad titles can include unsuitable duties.
Role and technology-related criteria can help.
